captions.instagram:
Paint and canvas are the write-offs every artist remembers. Three we see left off:

✔️ Art fair booth and jury fees. They're ordinary costs of selling your work.
✔️ A home studio. The space has to be used regularly and only for your art. The simplified method is $5 per square foot, up to 300 square feet.
✔️ Software and your portfolio site: design apps, domain and hosting, for the business share.

Our Tax Write Offs Tracker for Self Employed keeps receipts, mileage and home office in one workbook, sorted by Schedule C line.
